name: coloredin
description: ColoredIn: Color Your Future. A career-themed coloring app for girls.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
